name: Formation pitch diagram stays legible inside the viewport at 360px
description: When a visitor views the formation pitch diagram at a 360 pixel mobile viewport, the diagram fits within the viewport width without overflowing and its position markers remain large enough to read.

planSteps.description: Resize the viewport to 360 pixels wide
Read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match/<first-id> using the captured id
Open the Lineups tab or scroll to the formation pitch diagram
Verify the formation pitch diagram fits within the 360 pixel viewport width without overflowing its container
Verify the diagram's position markers render at a readable size of at least six pixels in diameter at the 360 pixel viewport
